searches.label: r4c2
searches.name: x-flip, 16 minibatches
searches.hypothesis: This is the best net (x-flip, no obs views) with 16 minibatches instead of 8. That doubles the gradient steps at the same sample count, which should help sample efficiency on the fixed budget. Earlier worlds and r3c5 found this within noise. More than 0.95 supports it. Less than 0.80 refutes it, which would mean the extra steps overfit each batch.

searches.label: r4c5
searches.name: LN transpose mb16 lr3e-3 headLN
searches.hypothesis: Adds per-cell LayerNorm to the head's pre-activation on top of mb16 + lr 3e-3. Removing LayerNorm gave 0, so this world has a scale deviation, and the head is the one remaining un-normalised layer. Normalising it could make the logits better conditioned. A score of 0.94 or more supports it. A score under 0.88 means the head norm removes useful magnitude information.

searches.label: r4c6
searches.name: No obs views + lr3e-3 + mb16
searches.hypothesis: Transpose+x-flip alone, with no extra obs views, on the tuned recipe (lr 3e-3, 16 minibatches). This tests whether the obs views are truly needed or whether the 0.36 without them was just a weak recipe or seed. The net is cheaper, so it gets slightly more samples. A score of 0.85 or more means the views are optional. A score near 0.36 or below confirms they matter.

searches.label: r3c4
searches.name: A+rotation views lr 3e-3
searches.hypothesis: The cheaper 0.81 net (set A layouts, 4 rotation obs views, r≈1.05, more samples) with lr 3e-3. A higher learning rate on a net that already learns quickly may convert its extra samples into higher success. Refuted if it scores below about 0.71 or collapses, which would show that lr 2e-3 is already at the edge of stability.

searches.label: r2c3
searches.name: B single: transpose+x-flip
searches.hypothesis: Only layout (1,0,1), the other 90° rotation, is used for the logits and the mask input, with no obs symmetries. If this is the true action frame it should score about 0.8. A 0 rules it out, unless all four single layouts score 0.

searches.label: r4c5
searches.name: xflip plain ent0.01 + 16 mb
searches.hypothesis: The plain x-flip net with two changes that are each within noise or helpful: ent_coef 0.01 and 16 minibatches. Together they should add exploration and optimisation steps without costing samples. Refuted if it scores below about 0.8. It counts as a gain only if it reaches about 0.95, ahead of the single-change runs in this round.

searches.label: r3c3
searches.name: single y-flip, no syms, new recipe
searches.hypothesis: This uses only the y-flipped layout on the plain obs, with ent_coef 0.01 and 16 minibatches, to test reversed action rows (as in world 7). If y-flip is the true layout, the score should be about 0.8 or higher. A score of 0 while another single layout scores refutes y-flip.
